features.lean4KernelFeature: Universe levels: zero/succ/max/imax/param normalization, instantiation, comparison.
features.formalBridgeStatus: source-present; earlier V71/KA gates exist, but no full executable Lean4Lean refinement theorem for the TS level engine is counted here.
features.requiredToClaimLeanEquivalence: Prove PSKernel level normalization/comparison refines Lean4Lean/Lean kernel level equivalence for every level expression accepted by the codec.

features.lean4KernelFeature: Small formal expression theory: bvar/sort/const/app/lam/forallE used by current VExpr bridge.
features.formalBridgeStatus: covered by KA12+ translation surface and KA13..KA31 environment bridge obligations for the supported ordinary/quot slices.
features.requiredToClaimLeanEquivalence: Preserve this bridge while extending to all kernel expression tags or document sound erasure/blocking rules.

features.lean4KernelFeature: Full Lean Expr tags include fvar/mvar/let/lit/mdata/proj plus kernel expression operations.
features.formalBridgeStatus: KA12 explicitly blocked fvar/mvar/let/lit/proj from the formal translation slice; runtime/source support exists for more tags but not full formal coverage.
features.requiredToClaimLeanEquivalence: Add formal translation and bridge obligations for letE, literals, projections, fvar/mvar policy, and metadata erasure.

features.lean4KernelFeature: Axiom, definition, theorem, opaque, and example declaration admission.
features.formalBridgeStatus: KA13..KA25 and KA30..KA31 provide conditional VDecl.WF, VEnv.WF, VEnv.LE, lookup, freshness, and defeq aggregate bridges for ordinary declarations.
features.requiredToClaimLeanEquivalence: Connect these conditional bridge facts to the executable PSKernel checker and codec, not just hand-constructed bridge witnesses.

features.lean4KernelFeature: Quotient declaration admission and quotient constants/defeq insertion.
features.formalBridgeStatus: KA26..KA29 prove conditional environment bridges for addQuot lookup, freshness/no-overwrite, defeq preservation, and aggregate packaging.
features.requiredToClaimLeanEquivalence: Prove quotient semantic soundness and executable refinement, not only environment-shape preservation.

features.lean4KernelFeature: Mutual definition block admission: add constants first, then add defining equations after block checking.
features.formalBridgeStatus: Lean4Lean has VDecl.WF.mutualDef and helper lemmas; PSKernel has source-level surfaces, but no KA counted mutualDef bridge obligations yet.
features.requiredToClaimLeanEquivalence: Prove VDecl.WF/VEnv.WF/VEnv.LE/lookup/defeq preservation for mutualDef blocks and then connect to executable checking.

features.lean4KernelFeature: Inductive and mutual/nested inductive admission: parameters, constructors, positivity, recursor generation, K/large-elim/structure behavior.
features.formalBridgeStatus: PSKernel has substantial source/runtime inductive code and older V71 assurance checkpoints, but KA12..KA31 deliberately excluded inductive/mutual/nested from the Lean4Lean bridge count.
features.requiredToClaimLeanEquivalence: Prove addInduct/VInductDecl.WF bridge, constructor/recursor environment effects, positivity/nested preprocessing soundness, and recursor reduction correspondence.

features.lean4KernelFeature: Recursor reduction, iota rules, K-like reductions, structure eta/projection behavior.
features.formalBridgeStatus: Runtime/source and arena evidence exist, but no full formal reduction/refinement theorem counted against Lean4Lean here.
features.requiredToClaimLeanEquivalence: Prove WHNF/reduction/refiner correspondence for recursor cases and projections under Lean4Lean semantics.

features.formalBridgeStatus: Implemented/source-bound but not proved as an executable refinement of Lean4Lean TypeChecker across all expression/declaration classes.
features.requiredToClaimLeanEquivalence: Prove executable PSKernel TypeScript checker accepts/rejects exactly the Lean4Lean checker for the declared kernel feature subset.

features.lean4KernelFeature: Definitional equality, WHNF, delta/beta/zeta/iota/projection/quotient reductions with fuel/resource behavior.
features.formalBridgeStatus: Runtime/source and arena evidence exist; full algorithmic conversion equivalence is not proven.
features.requiredToClaimLeanEquivalence: Prove PSKernel conversion/WHNF refines Lean4Lean including all supported reductions and conservative decline/error policy.

features.lean4KernelFeature: Environment contains constants/defeqs and extension order LE, with addConst/addDefEq/addQuot/addInduct/addDecl effects.
features.formalBridgeStatus: Strongly bridged for ordinary declarations and quotient; missing formal inductive/mutual block coverage.
features.requiredToClaimLeanEquivalence: Complete environment bridge for inductive and mutualDef, then connect bridge to executable addDecl.

features.lean4KernelFeature: Primitive constants, allowed axioms, Nat/String literals, and primitive checking policy.

features.requiredToClaimLeanEquivalence: Prove literal expansion and primitive/axiom policy agree with Lean4Lean/Lean for all accepted exports.

features.lean4KernelFeature: External proof object / lean4export ingestion and kernel-result classification.

features.requiredToClaimLeanEquivalence: Prove/validate codec translation preserves declarations, levels, expressions, and decline/error semantics against Lean4Lean replay.

features.lean4KernelFeature: Fuel/resource bounded checking and distinguishing reject/decline/error from semantic rejection.
